Context: Conditions for grant of benefits :

19. The MACPS contemplates merely placement on personal basis in the immediate higher Pay Level/ grant of financial benefits only and shall not amount to actual/functional promotion of the employees concerned. Therefore, no reservation orders/ roster shall apply to the MACPS, which shall extend its benefits uniformly to all eligible SC/ ST employees also.
